description: This file defines the ConceptSearchResult class which encapsulates the metadata associated with a concept search result in OpenMRS, including concept details, matching name, matched word, and a transient weight.

classes.name: ConceptSearchResult
classes.description: A class representing a search result for a concept, holding relevant concept information and metadata.

methods.name: ConceptSearchResult
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty search result.

methods.name: ConceptSearchResult
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing search result with word, concept, and concept name.

methods.name: ConceptSearchResult
methods.description: Constructor including weight for the search result.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept associated with this search result.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept associated with this search result.

methods.name: getConceptName
methods.description: Returns the concept name matched in the search.

methods.name: setConceptName
methods.description: Sets the concept name matched in the search.

methods.name: getWord
methods.description: Returns the word in the search string that was matched.

methods.name: setWord
methods.description: Sets the word in the search string that was matched.

methods.name: getTransientWeight
methods.description: Returns the transient weight associated with this search result.

methods.name: setTransientWeight
methods.description: Sets the transient weight for this search result.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the concept.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code, primarily based on the concept.
